newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brinker estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brinker estimates raised.

text.p: Robertson, Stephens & Co said it raised its estimates on restaurant operator Brinker International Inc following the company's report of fiscal fourth quarter earnings that beat expectations.
-- raised fiscal 1998 forecast to $1.00 a share from $0.95 and said it believes "our assumptions are still conservative."
-- Brinker reported fiscal fourth quarter, ended June 25, earnings of $0.29 a share versus Hambrecht's $0.25 a share. For fiscal 1997, company reported earnings per share of $0.81.
-- company owns and franchises over 600 restaurants in many countries.
